changelog:
atlassian-bitbucket v1.0.2 changelog

- Documentation expanded with new usage recommendations for exploration and search.
- Added command documentation for recursive directory listing (`tree`), code search (`search`), and branch comparison (`compare`).
- Updated directory listing and file read commands to clarify handling of branches and root directory.
- Added notes about command result pagination and result limits.
- No code changes—documentation only.
summary: Browse Bitbucket Cloud repos, review pull requests, read diffs, check branches. Use when user mentions PRs, code changes, diffs, branches, Bitbucket, or repo...
